_about: Licences reviewed for the core track (core/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). tools/ci/check_licences.py fails CI when a dependency's licence cannot be met from this list. Add an identifier only after reading its text and checking it against the rule: nothing linked into the apps stronger than MPL-2.0; the server may use AGPL-compatible licences.

apps.MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft, the ceiling for the apps (UniFFI runtime)

allo-isolate.why: its Cargo.toml declares none; its LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 (read 6 November 2026)
